subject: Russian language
hook: RUSSIAN LANGUAGE IS NOT WHAT YOU THINK
angle: Russian is the most spoken native language in Europe, not English or German
angle_support: It is the most spoken native language in Europe, the most spoken Slavic language, and the most geographically widespread language of Eurasia.
Russian has over 210 million total speakers worldwide.
title: The Most Spoken Native Language in Europe
description: Contrary to common belief, Russian holds the top spot for native speakers in Europe. This video breaks down its linguistic reach and influence across the continent.
narration: RUSSIAN LANGUAGE IS NOT WHAT YOU THINK You picture English or German as the dominant native tongue of Europe. You assume one of those leads the pack. It was actually closer to Russian all along. With over 210 million speakers worldwide, Russian holds the title for the most spoken native language across the European continent. It remains the most geographically widespread language of Eurasia and the most spoken Slavic language today. Geography and pure numbers make it the undisputed leader of Europe.
